question: What noise levels has TfL itself reported for Liverpool Street to Bethnal Green?
norm_question: what noise levels has tfl itself reported for liverpool street to bethnal green

answer.text: In FOI-1231-2425 (published 8 August 2024), a TfL FOI case officer reported Central line train operator's cab readings from 24 June 2024 of 87 dB LAeq eastbound for Liverpool Street to Bethnal Green and 86 dB LAeq westbound for Bethnal Green to Liverpool Street.

verified_claims.text: In FOI-1231-2425 (published 8 August 2024), a TfL FOI case officer reported that Central line noise measurements taken on 24 June 2024 from within the train operator's cab recorded 87 dB LAeq eastbound on Liverpool Street to Bethnal Green.

citations.quote:

June 2024, these measurements were taken from within the train operator's cab.

verified_claims.text: In the same 24 June 2024 in-cab dataset in FOI-1231-2425, the TfL FOI case officer reported 86 dB LAeq westbound on Bethnal Green to Liverpool Street, and stated that Central line readings are carried out on a bi-monthly period.

citations.quote: Readings are carried out on a bi-monthly period.

verified_claims.text: Separately from TfL's own primary disclosures, a secondary press article in Brixton Buzz (27 January 2026, citing information from JRPass) reported a figure of 92.8 decibels for Liverpool Street to Bethnal Green on the Central line.

citations.quote: Liverpool Street to Bethnal Green (Central line) – 92.8 decibels
